title: SourcingPackManifest
description: Manifest for a Sourcing Pack. Declares: the source-side panels the Pack contributes (each composed of a closed map of `ContributionSlot`s, where every slot owns its own JSON Schema, default resolver, and the Contributions posted into it during a Run; panel stratification is emergent from `dependencyPanels`), optional additive slots the Pack adds onto engine-owned Target Blackboard panels (Definition/Archetype/Statement only -- Granularity/Evidence/Confidence panels were removed in Wave 9), KS list, optional Instructions Provider, requested external tools (upper bound). Engine validates the panel DAG (Pack-owned source panels + engine-owned target panels + Pack slot extensions) at registration; cycles are rejected. Pack-owned source-panel names SHOULD be Pack-namespaced (e.g. `itip:SourceUnit`); when two Packs in the same Run declare the same panel name with non-identical `slots` map, the engine rejects registration (collision). Identical panel declarations across Packs are merged silently.

id.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the Pack.

instructionsProvider.description: URI of the Pack's Instructions Provider descriptor.

panels.description: Pack-owned Source Blackboard panel declarations. Engine-owned Target Blackboard panels (Definition/Archetype/Statement) MUST NOT appear here; use `extendsPanels` to add additive slots onto them. The dropped Granularity/Evidence/Confidence panels (Wave 9 removal) are no longer accepted anywhere.

name.description: Pack-namespaced panel name. SHOULD match `<packPrefix>:<PanelName>` (e.g. `itip:SourceUnit`); engine collision-rejects identical names with non-identical slots maps across Packs.

description.description: Optional free-form description of the panel. NOT used by the engine; surfaced in audit and operator UIs only. Stratification is emergent from `dependencyPanels` (no separate layer/rank concept).

slots.description: Closed map binding each slot name accepted by this panel to its `ContributionSlot` `{schemaUri, defaultResolver}`. One entry = one slot. Schema URI resolution: engine looks up each schema as a resource bundled in the Pack JAR at `/META-INF/gsmarc/<URI-path-tail>`; falls back to the configured Schema Registry if any. The URI is informational + cache key; no network fetch is implied. RunConfig may override `defaultResolver` per `(panel, slot)`.

schemaUri.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the per-slot JSON Schema.

defaultResolver.description: Default `ContributionResolver` strategy for folding competing Contributions of THIS slot within this panel. RunConfig may override per `(panel, slot)`.

dependencyPanels.description: DAG edges. Engine-owned panel names allowed for upward bridges.

extendsPanels.description: Optional additive slots the Pack registers onto engine-owned Target Blackboard panels (Definition/Archetype/Statement). Each value is a map binding a Pack-namespaced slot name (e.g. `itip:Refined`) to a `ContributionSlot` (composite child holding `{schemaUri, defaultResolver}` plus the live `contributions` list at runtime). Engine-defined slots remain closed and cannot be redefined. The Granularity/Evidence/Confidence panels are no longer engine-owned (Wave 9 removal): Granularity policy lives in `RunConfig.granularityPolicy`, evidence is now an optional `Contribution.evidence` property, and confidence is the per-Contribution `confidence` value (synthesis is a regular Statement-shaping KS). Use case: a domain Pack augments Statement with a refinement slot that downstream domain KSs read alongside the engine-defined Draft slot.

schemaUri.description: Versioned gsmarc:// URI of the per-slot JSON Schema.

defaultResolver.description: Default `ContributionResolver` strategy for this Pack-additive slot. RunConfig may override per `(panel, slot)`.

knowledgeSources.description: URIs of KS descriptors shipped by the Pack.

requestedExternalTools.description: Upper-bound list of external tools any KS in this Pack may declare in its descriptor's externalTools[]. Operator's RunConfig narrows further by binding names to host paths.
